check_version_numpy: check if the installed numpy package satisfies a version requirement like numpy>=1.20.0
check_version_scipy: check if the installed scipy package satisfies a version requirement like scipy<=1.10.0
check_version_operator: check if an installed package version satisfies comparison operators >=, <=, >, <, ==, or !=
parse_version_string: parse a version string into comparable tuple components for numeric and non-numeric parts
check_version_fallback: check package version with fallback to __version__ attribute when importlib.metadata is unavailable
